gaps.explanation: Statement p4 (Totals column) prints Operating transfers in 27,330 = General 8,330 + Street 19,000. Detail records the General Fund combining schedule (p12) per sub-fund column, gross: Culture and Recreation +55,777 (index 52), plus Street Transfers In 19,000 (p13, index 65) = 74,777. The General Fund column of p4 nets its sub-fund transfers (sub-fund total (11,670) on p12 = 8,330 - 20,000). 74,777 - 27,330 = 47,447 = 55,777 - 8,330: transfers between the General Fund's own sub-funds, printed gross on p12 and netted on p4. Both printed; no fix.

Statement p4 prints Operating transfers out (28,330) = General (20,000) + Other (8,330). Detail (gross per sub-fund, p12 and p15): General (48,706) idx 50 + Medical Clinic (12,500) idx 51 + Sinking (6,241) idx 54 + Lottery (8,330) idx 75 = 75,777. 75,777 - 28,330 = 47,447, the same General Fund intra-fund sub-fund transfers as on the transfers-in side (p12 prints them per sub-fund; p4 nets them within the General column). No fix.

Proprietary funds statement p7, OTHER FINANCING USES: Operating transfers in (out) Combined Utility 1,000 (Sanitation blank; Total 1,000); no business-type transfer line is in detail. Add Combined Utility Transfers In 1,000. 0 + 1,000 = 1,000 = statement transfers_net.
